midpoint_proof: D is non-increasing and S non-decreasing in p. If V(lo)=V(hi)=v is the max, then D(hi)>=v and S(lo)>=v, so for lo<=P<=hi: D(P)>=D(hi)>=v and S(P)>=S(lo)>=v, hence V(P)>=v, and v is the max.
